vars.label: FRP
vars.def: Fire radiative power DENSITY of the detection.
vars.calc: Raw VNP14IMGML FRP divided by the pixel area DS*DT (Scholten's FireIO.read_VNP14IMGML). Real pixel FRP in MW = frp * DS * DT.
vars.caveats: Density, not MW: sums of frp (nb_frp_*, aggregates) are sums of densities - use frp*DS*DT for physical totals. Radiant power only (~10-20 % of heat release). Attenuated by smoke/pyroCu around onset.
vars.source: Fire Atlas NFP (VIIRS 375 m)

vars.label: Pixel area
vars.def: Pixel footprint area.
vars.caveats: Covariate for scan angle; larger edge pixels are less sensitive.
vars.source: derived

vars.label: Pixel size, along-scan
vars.def: VIIRS along-scan pixel size.
vars.caveats: Grows towards the swath edge (0.36-0.8 km): a scan-angle proxy.
vars.source: Fire Atlas NFP

vars.label: Pixel size, along-track
vars.def: VIIRS along-track pixel size.
vars.caveats: Scan-angle proxy.
vars.source: Fire Atlas NFP

vars.label: atlas_version
vars.def: Which fire-atlas release the row comes from: 0 = published Arctic-Boreal Fire Atlas (2013-2023), 1 = Scholten-code extension (2024-2025).
vars.caveats: QC/sensitivity flag, never a feature. The extension was compared with the published atlas on the bridge year 2023: ~5 % fewer pixels and fires, a few missing overpasses, DS/DT shipped swapped (corrected in the loader), identical FRP per matched pixel, 88 % of pixels within 50 m. Check that results hold with atlas_version == 0 only.
vars.source: config

vars.label: lc_map_year
vars.def: Year of the land-cover map used for this pixel.
vars.calc: Fire year - 1, capped at LC_LAST_MAP_YEAR (2022, the last C3S map available).
vars.caveats: 2024 and 2025 both use the 2022 map (2 and 3 years old instead of 1): fuel changes from the 2023 season are not in the map, only in burned_frac_* (atlas detections).
vars.source: C3S Land Cover

vars.label: near_uncertain_pcb
vars.def: Within UNCERTAIN_RADIUS_KM (25 km) and +-UNCERTAIN_DT_H (24 h) of a probable (P) or uncertain (U) inventory event, or on its credited fire within that window.
vars.calc: labels.uncertain_flags against pcb_uncertain_events.parquet (position = corrected centroid if the event matched a fire, else the atlas point).
vars.caveats: Such events are never labelled. These samples are also near_pcb = True so they cannot become negatives. A confirmed positive near one keeps label = 1 and still carries this flag.
vars.source: derived

vars.label: pcb_step_offset
vars.def: Which overpass made the pixel an active-pyroCb pixel: 0 = last overpass at or before onset, 1 = first overpass after onset, -1 = not a positive.
vars.calc: Step index minus the event's si_grid.
vars.caveats: Outcome bookkeeping - never a feature (1 = after onset).
vars.source: derived

vars.label: uncertain_pcb_id
vars.def: Id(s) of the probable/uncertain inventory event(s) behind near_uncertain_pcb (';'-joined).
vars.caveats: Lookup table: OUTPUT_DATA/datacube/pcb_uncertain_events.csv.
vars.source: derived

vars.label: v1_domain
vars.def: 1 = fire inside the spatial domain of the published atlas (v1); 0 = only in the extension's wider domain.
vars.calc: Extension final-perimeter attribute v1_domain, joined by mergid; 1 for all published-atlas years.
vars.caveats: Restrict to v1_domain == 1 to compare 2024-2025 like-for-like with 2013-2023.
vars.source: Fire Atlas final perimeters (extension)

vars.label: Spread direction
vars.def: Direction the fire is moving at the pixel: true bearing, clockwise from north.
vars.calc: The unit spread vector (spread_ux, spread_uy: this pixel minus its predecessor, in the EPSG:3571 grid frame) rotated into true north - both ends projected to lon/lat and the geodesic forward azimuth taken (pyproj). Stored at 8 bits (1.4 deg steps).
vars.caveats: NaN without a predecessor (new lobes). Drawn as arrows on a screen grid: each arrow is the mean direction of the cells under it, its length how consistent they are, its colour their mean spread rate.
vars.source: derived from Fire Atlas NFP (spread_ux, spread_uy)

vars.label: Spread distance
vars.def: Distance to the predecessor pixel.
vars.caveats: NaN without predecessor.
vars.source: derived

vars.label: Spread rate
vars.def: Local spread rate.
vars.caveats: Biased by overpass spacing (12 h) and pixel size; a lower bound on fast runs.
vars.source: derived

vars.label: Aspect (downslope direction)
vars.def: Aspect: downslope direction, degrees clockwise from true north (0 = north-facing slope descends to the north).
vars.calc: arctan2 of the DEM gradient at the pixel (true metres), then degrees mod 360.
vars.caveats: CIRCULAR (0 and 360 are the same direction) and undefined on flat ground; trees split it arbitrarily - consider a derived 'southness' for linear models.
vars.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-90

vars.label: Elevation
vars.def: Elevation.
vars.calc: Mean of the 90 m DEM over a 200 m-radius disc around the pixel.
vars.caveats: DEM is a surface model (includes canopy).
vars.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-90

vars.label: Roughness (375 m, inside the pixel)
vars.def: Terrain roughness: standard deviation of elevation in the window; square window 375 m on a side (inside the VIIRS pixel).
vars.calc: NaN-aware FFT convolution of the 90 m DEM with an area-weighted square window in true metres.
vars.caveats: 375 m = inside the VIIRS pixel (only ~4 x 8 DEM cells); needs >= 25 % land in the window.
vars.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-90

vars.label: Roughness (~2 km)
vars.def: Terrain roughness: standard deviation of elevation in the window; square window 1875 m on a side (5 x 5 VIIRS pixels, ~2 km).
vars.calc: NaN-aware FFT convolution of the 90 m DEM with an area-weighted square window in true metres.
vars.caveats: 375 m = inside the VIIRS pixel (only ~4 x 8 DEM cells); needs >= 25 % land in the window.
vars.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-90

vars.label: Slope
vars.def: Slope.
vars.calc: arctan of the DEM gradient (true metres per degree at each latitude), averaged over the 200 m disc.
vars.caveats: 90 m cells smooth steep terrain.
vars.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-90

vars.label: Slope along spread
vars.def: Terrain slope in the direction the fire is moving: > 0 running upslope, < 0 downslope.
vars.calc: DEM gradient (true-frame, rotated into the EPSG:3571 grid frame) dotted with the unit spread vector.
vars.caveats: NaN without spread vector.
vars.source: DEM + spread vector

vars.label: TPI (375 m, inside the pixel)
vars.def: Terrain position: pixel elevation minus the mean elevation in the window (> 0 ridge / peak, < 0 valley); square window 375 m on a side (inside the VIIRS pixel).
vars.calc: NaN-aware FFT convolution of the 90 m DEM with an area-weighted square window in true metres.
vars.caveats: 375 m = inside the VIIRS pixel (only ~4 x 8 DEM cells); needs >= 25 % land in the window.
vars.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-90

vars.label: TPI (~2 km)

vars.label: Distance to nearest public road
vars.def: Distance from the pixel centre to the nearest PUBLIC road (motorway ... unclassified, residential; no tracks).
vars.calc: Road vertices densified to <= 150 m in EPSG:3571, nearest-vertex distance (KD-tree); capped at 100 km.
vars.caveats: OSM is today's network, not the 2013-2023 one; track mapping is patchier in Siberia than in Canada / Scandinavia; the cap makes the variable saturate in roadless wilderness.
vars.source: OpenStreetMap (Geofabrik extracts, current network)

vars.label: Distance to nearest road or track

vars.source: OpenStreetMap (Geofabrik extracts, current network)

vars.label: Land-cover class (incl. water)
vars.def: Land-cover class at the pixel.
vars.calc: 300 m map of the PREVIOUS year (fire year - 1); nearest cell.
vars.caveats: Categorical - do not treat as numeric. Version change v2.0.7 -> v2.1.1 at map year 2016 (fuel group unchanged at 99.7 % of fire locations).

vars.source: C3S land cover 300 m
